description: Generate /home/workspace/zo_sentinel/signal_training_corpus.py — a stdlib + requests module that captures paired (student, teacher) signal-scoring examples for future RLSD-style training of a small custom MCP signal scorer. THIS IS NOT A TRAINING SCRIPT — it is a data-collection contract. RLSD CONTEXT (must be preserved in module docstring): the eventual training loop has three roles — (1) STUDENT, a small model (likely Qwen 0.5B or Phi-3 mini on tower) producing scores, (2) PRIVILEGED TEACHER, the same model architecture run with frontier-grade prompting context (full MCP fingerprint, README, tool schemas, network observations) providing dense token-level magnitude signals, (3) ENVIRONMENT, the existing frontier model in the escalation ladder (Sonnet/Opus via escalation.py) producing the sparse correctness direction signal. This module captures the data needed to populate roles 2 and 3 over time. MODULE CONTRACT: exposes one public class TrainingCorpusWriter with two methods: capture_pair(mcp_id, fingerprint_dict, student_score, teacher_score, env_verdict='unknown', metadata=None) and flush(). PERSISTENCE: writes to a new DuckDB table 'mcp_signal_training_corpus' via existing write_service at http://127.0.0.1:8772/write. SCHEMA (must be created idempotently on first capture, via write_service /execute with CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS): mcp_id VARCHAR, captured_at TIMESTAMP, fingerprint_json VARCHAR, student_score_json VARCHAR (the small/cheap model's scores across the 6 trust signals), teacher_score_json VARCHAR (the frontier teacher's scores with full context), env_verdict VARCHAR (the sparse direction signal: 'agree' if student and teacher agree within tolerance, 'disagree' if they materially differ, 'unknown' if no env signal yet), magnitude_delta_json VARCHAR (per-signal numeric deltas student - teacher, computed at capture time), metadata_json VARCHAR. PRIMARY KEY (mcp_id, captured_at). CRITICAL: this module must work in TWO modes — (a) live capture during normal scoring, where student_score is the production scorer's output and teacher_score is filled in lazily by a separate enrichment daemon (still to be built); (b) backfill mode, called by a one-shot script that re-scores the existing mcp_signal_scores table with frontier escalation.ask() to produce the teacher_score for every existing row. The class must NEVER block the production scorer — if write_service is down, capture_pair logs to /home/workspace/logs/signal_training_corpus_failures.log and returns silently. The flush method is a no-op for now (we write per-call) but reserved for future batched-write optimization. INCLUDE: a method estimate_disagreement(mcp_id) that queries the corpus and returns the count of disagree rows for that mcp — used by manual triage to find MCPs the student reliably gets wrong. INCLUDE: an integration_hint() classmethod that returns a multi-line string showing exactly the import + capture_pair call a downstream daemon should add to wire this in. Module ends with a __main__ that runs a self-test: instantiates the writer, captures one synthetic example with hardcoded fake scores, queries write_service to verify the row landed, prints success or failure. Self-test exits 0 on success. Imports allowed: stdlib + requests. NO IMPORT OF escalation, signal_analyser, or any heavy mesh module — keep this module decoupled from the production scorer so it can be tested in isolation. Target: 220-280 lines including docstrings.
